description: Firebase administration (Firestore and Authentication). project_id defaults to firebaseMcp.projectId. Actions: create_document(path, data) fails if it exists, update_document(path, data) changes only the given fields, create_user(email?, password?, display_name?, phone?, email_verified?), update_user(uid, email?, password?, display_name?, phone?, email_verified?), disable_user(uid, disabled?). Destructive (confirm:true): set_document(path, data, merge?) replaces the whole document unless merge is true, delete_document(path), delete_user(uid).

params.description: Action parameters; destructive actions also need confirm: true

name: firebase_admin
